item.title: security: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
item.description:
Microsoft reports that threat actors are using GSocket on compromised Linux servers to maintain encrypted remote access and command-and-control after the initial vulnerability has been patched. The post focuses on detection, investigation, and remediation guidance for this activity.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector
item.description:
Microsoft reports that in October 2026 the financially motivated threat actor Storm-3358 started targeting financial-sector organizations using the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Star Blizzard refines phishing and malware delivery with the RedFlick technique
item.description:
Microsoft says it has observed Russian state actor Star Blizzard since January 2026 using large-scale phishing, compromised website accounts, and a new malware delivery method it tracks as RedFlick. The update focuses on the actor’s improved detection evasion and delivery techniques.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
